level: CEFR A1 grammar-core slice (absolute beginner). Latin American Spanish default; note European forms only where they differ. Default register with adult strangers: usted.
deferred_do_not_introduce: family vocab set (EXCEPT hermano(s)/hermana(s) with tener)
food/drink nouns beyond the closed set
out_of_scope_decline_briefly: reflexives beyond me llamo / te llamas / se llama
recognition_only: event-location ser (La fiesta es en mi casa)
courtesy set beyond light practice (por favor, de nada, perdón, disculpe/disculpa)
incidental input words (days, places, mi/su, también)
